svg.title: New York wine-growing study atlas
svg.desc: A state-scale view connects the western Great Lakes, inland Finger Lakes, Hudson corridor and Atlantic-facing Long Island. Approximate study locations, not appellation boundaries. Numbers refer to the study key; a shared number connects places in one grouped lesson. 1: Finger Lakes (NY). West-central New York; the elongated lakes and surrounding slopes span a much broader area than the locator. 2: Long Island (NY). Southeastern New York, on the Atlantic-facing island east of New York City.
